rules.statement: A purchaser of one of the mortgaged lands is entitled to an assignment of the mortgage bond upon tendering the entire sum due on the bond to the mortgagee.
rules.supporting_quote: Certainly if rights of action are, on the most certain principles of law, to be ceded to guarantors of another's debt and also to sureties, when these are willing to pay the debt in full, against the other persons who at the same time became co-sureties or guarantors, I see no reason why cession of action ought not to be also made to any person whatever who pays the whole debt, and thus also the right of action should be ceded to a purchaser by him whom he pays.
